_note: Voice casting for Fifth Floor Tenant (1st person, past tense: Ravi Anand). Ravi's own lines stay on the narrator voice (gemini.voices c-ravi-anand = "narrator"). gemini.narrator overrides config/tts.json gemini.narrator. Main voices kept distinct from knot-mender and down-is-where-i-say. lexicon: Kokoro IPA; respell: Gemini only. Cast 2026-11-13, not yet approved by Ben.

respell._note: Gemini only: words replaced in the text sent to Gemini.

narrator.style: Warm, anxious, chatty young British man, a night caretaker and trained surveyor telling his own story; out of his depth and honest about it; talks more when frightened; practical and fond when the job is in his hands; natural pace with clear pauses between paragraphs

c-walter-ossery.style: Gravelly, unhurried old British working man at the end of a long shift; plain and steady; gives instructions

c-nessa-wrobel.style: Blunt woman of seventy-one with a faint Polish cadence; short field orders; dry and gruffly caring

c-lou-mabbott.style: Ordinary British neighbour and bakery worker, tired at one in the morning, worried but kind; plain everyday speech

c-kit-dalisay.style: Fast, slangy young Londoner; narrates routes like a satnav; goes quiet and formal when scared

c-imogen-tarrant.style: Warm, quick British woman with corporate polish; speaks in options; lowers her voice, never raises it

c-bastien-thewlis.style: Soft, exact, old-fashioned British clerk; polite, regretful, quietly menacing

c-the-proprietor.style: Slow and literal, like a kind grandfather reading a contract aloud
